title: Grateful Dead Live at Dane County Coliseum on 1973-02-15
source: Recording Info: SBD MR > R (Bob Menke) > R (Pat Lee); Transfer Info: Technics 1506 w/Lamb Labs Dolby decoder > WAV (24bit/96k) > Apogee Mini Me 24/96 > Apogee Mini DAC monitoring and mastering > FLAC; Mastered By Matt Smith

ai_review.summary: Good soundboard recording of an exhilarating show that still thrills listeners, though it isn’t as pristine as some later copies.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers are clearly excited by the performance – one even says the show “still gets me off” – indicating a strong musical experience. The only technical note is that this particular copy doesn’t sound quite as nice as the April 13 2013 recording, suggesting solid but not exceptional audio quality.

ai_rating.rationale: Two enthusiastic reviews (5 and 4 stars) highlight a great performance; the sole comment about sound quality is mild, leading to an overall high rating with moderate confidence due to limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear enough for enjoyment but not as nice‑sounding as the referenced 4/13/13 soundboard copy; no major defects reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Listeners report the concert remains a favorite and highly energizing, though specific set‑list details were not mentioned in the reviews.
